name: Get Active Opportunities Status Value
purpose: Returns the total opportunity value per status as JSON, for charts and list views. Finds Opportunities by ActiveInd (default 1), sorts by status, and walks each status group with sub-summaries to build {"name":"Opportunities","<Status>":<total>} inside an array. Restores the original layout.
